metadata.name: clawrush
metadata.description: ClawRush: shared skill x VRF claw cabinet on MagicBlock Ephemeral Rollups

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Signer only the VRF program can produce (scoped to this program).

errors.name: VrfPending
errors.msg: A VRF grip roll is pending

errors.name: StaleVrfCallback
errors.msg: VRF callback does not match the pending drop

errors.name: SessionKeyNotAllowed
errors.msg: Signer is neither the player nor a valid session key

errors.name: StillQueued
errors.msg: Player is still queued or playing

errors.name: PayoutTooLarge
errors.msg: Prize exceeds max payout per round

types.name: CabinetConfig
docs: L1, never delegated. Cabinet parameters + mint registry + claimed totals.

fields.name: validator
docs: ER validator the cabinet is delegated to (TEE validator for the private mystery vault).

fields.name: play_price
docs: Credit price in base units of mints[0] (demo USDC).

fields.name: mints
docs: mints[0] is the payment mint (demo USDC). All four are prize mints.

fields.name: total_claimed
docs: Monotonic total paid out on L1 by `claim_prize`, per mint. Used in the solvency rule.

types.name: CabinetState
docs: Delegated to the ER. Everything here is public: claw, capsules, turn, queue, last result.

fields.name: move_seq
docs: Last client move sequence number (makes otherwise identical move txs unique).

fields.name: turn_owner
docs: Pubkey::default() when no turn is active.

fields.name: vrf_nonce
docs: Incremented on every drop; the callback must echo it back.

fields.name: total_won
docs: Monotonic total won on the ER, per mint (claimed or not).

fields.name: mint_idx
docs: Index into config.mints. For Mystery capsules this is 0 and `amount` is 0 until revealed.

fields.name: tier
docs: Mystery only: tier label 1 = dust, 2 = mid, 3 = jackpot.

types.name: KeeperRole
docs: Low-privilege restock role, so a hosted keeper never holds the cabinet authority (also the upgrade key).
A keeper can only add capsules that pass the same bounds and solvency checks as an authority restock.

types.name: MysteryVault
docs: Delegated to the TEE ER with a private EphemeralPermission (no members):
nobody can read it through the RPC; only program instructions executing inside the TEE.
entries[i] belongs to cabinet.capsules[i] when that capsule is a Mystery capsule.

types.name: PlayerProfile
docs: L1 home; delegated to the ER while the player is playing, undelegated to cash out.

fields.name: cabinet_id
docs: Profiles are per cabinet: credits and pending prizes belong to one cabinet's mints and vault.

fields.name: session_key
docs: Scoped session key: may sign join_queue / move_claw / drop_claw only.

fields.name: pending
docs: Won but not yet claimed on L1, per mint index.
